name: marvin-gripper-percam
_comment: Gripper rig recorded with one compressed topic per camera instead of the
stitched /quad_tile mosaic, and with gripper feedback on /info/gripper_feedback_*
rather than /gripper/feedback_*. This is the layout to prefer when recording:
each camera keeps its native resolution and its own capture stamp, both of
The feedback topic publishes a 5-component Float32MultiArray whose meaning is
positional -- component 0 is the measured opening, the rest are velocity,
current and two temperatures -- so state_indices names the index rather than
relying on the (empty) MultiArray dimension labels.
Recordings in this generation sometimes omit /control/gripperValue* entirely.
Convert those with --missing-topic-policy fill, which reconstructs the gripper
command from the measured feedback; the recipe mcap-gripper-percam does this.
